_readme: Hand-curated story structure. The updater fills in anything missing (marked "auto": true) and never overwrites entries you edit here unless they are still auto. 'canon' = the option the story actually followed (from the next post).

2101703241687863782.title: Incoming Transmission: What Is the Amalgaverse?

2102065567318638730.title: The Amalgaverse Begins
2102065567318638730.question: Do you join the Alt. Enterprise-D and its crew on their maiden voyage?

options.label: Yes — sign aboard
options.summary: Set phasers, zats, force lances and pulse pistols to fun. Become the 20th crew member.

options.label: No — stay home
options.summary: Finish the cookie. Stay on your Earth.

2102427955456815176.title: Four Contacts, One Ship
2102427955456815176.question: Four crises. One ship. No back-up. Where do we set course first?

options.label: Contact One — The Ghost Ship
options.summary: A derelict vessel cycling a fragmented Federation distress call. No lights, no drive, no life signs.

options.label: Contact Two — The Heist
options.summary: A Ferengi shadow auction for Artifact Omicron-8 — possibly an outlawed subspace weapon.

options.label: Contact Three — The Delivery
options.summary: Extract intelligence broker Harven Zax, wanted by Romulans, the Orion Syndicate and a Klingon Great House.

options.label: Contact Four — The Fracture
options.summary: Kirin Station Outpost Gamma-3 has gone silent. 23 crew. No beacon. No debris.

2102790343305626057.title: How Do We Get Aboard?
2102790343305626057.question: A derelict freighter sits inside a pulsing spatial anomaly. Whose advice do you follow?

options.label: Scotty — beam aboard
options.summary: Transport straight to the bridge in a lull between pulses. Fast — but extraction may not be instant.

options.label: Sheppard — fly the jumper in
options.summary: Park the puddle jumper in the open hangar bay for a clean getaway. Long hike to the bridge.

options.label: Garak — enter via the hull breach
options.summary: Jumper, then EVA through the rupture midway between bridge and hangar. Slow, exposed, unexpected.

options.label: McKay — skip this one
options.summary: "The three worst ideas since the Matrix sequels." Don't board at all.

2103152730714063183.title: Choose the Away Team
2103152730714063183.question: Two ATA-gene pilots lead the jumper team. Pick a row, A through D.

options.label: Row A
options.summary: Sheppard · Data · G'Kar · Dr. Fraiser

options.label: Row B
options.summary: Sheppard · Dr. McCoy · Aeryn Sun · Teal'c

options.label: Row C
options.summary: O'Neill · Carter · Garak · Odo

options.label: Row D
options.summary: O'Neill · McKay · Rommie · Daniel Jackson

2103515118818697677.title: The Hangar Doors
2103515118818697677.question: The hangar doors are jammed open to space. Whose advice do you take?

options.label: Rommie — crank them shut by hand
options.summary: Her android frame handles vacuum. Slow and exposed — and the anomaly's pulses could knock her offline.

options.label: McKay — run a hard line
options.summary: Power the dead servos from the jumper. Works — but may bleed the jumper's reserves. Potentially. Ish.

options.label: O'Neill — leave it open, go in
options.summary: They're already in EV suits. Fastest way in — but any retreat means crossing vacuum again.

2103877507585913079.title: The Faint Contact
2103877507585913079.question: Do you head straight for the bridge, or detour toward the strange reading?

options.label: Rommie — beeline for the bridge
options.summary: Confirm every breach sealed and the ship secured before going deeper — safe and methodical, but the failing containment field might not wait.

options.label: Daniel & McKay — chase the reading
options.summary: Detour to the one compartment still holding a dying containment field — maybe a survivor, maybe something the field was built to hold.

2104239896114213067.title: The Corridor Sentinel
2104239896114213067.question: As the hulking utility unit advances down the corridor, what do you do?

options.label: Fall back — let McKay lead the retreat
options.summary: Retreat down the corridor with McKay setting the pace — safe for now, but it leaves the unit's intentions, and the route to the bridge, unresolved.

options.label: Rommie — reach out and override the unit
options.summary: Have Rommie attempt a machine-to-machine override — a shot at a new ally or ship access, but she could get compromised instead.

options.label: O'Neill & Daniel — light it up with the P-90s
options.summary: Trust the P-90s to put it down fast — decisive, though the armor plating might shrug the rounds off entirely.

2104602282491019492.title: Into the Breach
2104602282491019492.question: Do you seal up and cross into the breached, vacuum-exposed section, or leave it sealed and find another way around?

options.label: Away team — seal up, cross the breach
options.summary: Seal the compartment, vent it to the breached section, and cross in EV suits — the fastest route to the bridge, but anything not secured, Rommie included, goes out with the escaping air.

options.label: Away team — find another way around
options.summary: Leave the compartment sealed and take a longer route to the bridge — safer for the team, but it burns time the fading containment field and ebbing power source can't spare.

2104964671002251496.title: First Across the Gap
2104964671002251496.question: So who leads the way across?

options.label: O'Neill — pull rank and jump first
options.summary: As team leader, O'Neill volunteers to make the tethered leap himself — commanding, but age and reflexes stack the odds against him if the mag locks don't catch.

options.label: Daniel — younger and more spry, he goes
options.summary: Daniel argues he's the fitter bet for the leap than Jack — reasonable odds on agility, though he's the least combat-hardened of the three.

options.label: Rommie — send the android, she risks least
options.summary: Rommie points out vacuum won't do to her what it would do to them — the safest bet for the team, but it leaves her alone on the far side first if the tether fails.

2105327058440339834.title: Access Denied
2105327058440339834.question: With the door refusing to budge, how should the team reach the containment compartment?

options.label: Daniel — lead a stroll across the hull
options.summary: Exit through the breach and cross the exposed hull to a topside airlock — fast, but a stray anomalous pulse mid-crossing could scramble Rommie's systems.

options.label: O'Neill — blow the door with C4
options.summary: Charge the door with just a smidge of C4 — quick and satisfying, but risks shrapnel, structural damage, or waking whatever's on the other side.

options.label: Team — turn back and find another route
options.summary: Abandon the crossing and retreat to search for a different way in — the safest call, but it costs time and concedes the door.

2105689446930694283.title: Counter to Zero
2105689446930694283.question: Should the team let the android's charge cycle finish, or interrupt it and search the bridge instead?

options.label: Team — let the cycle finish
options.summary: Let the charge complete and question the awakened android for answers — fast information, but no guarantee it's friendly, and the skittering in the walls keeps closing in.

options.label: Team — restart the charge cycle
options.summary: Interrupt the cycle to keep the android dormant and search the bridge instead — safer and more cautious, but leaves the crew without a possible ally against whatever's in the walls.

2106051834058342626.title: The Android's Warning
2106051834058342626.question: Should the away team re-contain the newly awakened android, try to talk her into cooperating, or have Rommie force a neural link to seize control of her?

options.label: Team — put her back under
options.summary: Flip the containment field back on and return Maia to stasis — safe, but leaves the team without an ally or any answers about the ship.

options.label: Daniel — talk her into helping
options.summary: Let Daniel explain the situation and propose working together to restore ship functions — diplomatic, but she's already warned them off and threatened legal action.

options.label: Rommie — neural-link to seize control
options.summary: Have Rommie force a neural link to take over Maia outright — fast if it works, but forcing a peer AI is a gamble that could turn hostile.

2106414222142005299.title: The Interface Request
2106414222142005299.question: Do you allow Maia to interface with Rommie?

options.label: Rommie — allow the interface
options.summary: Let Maia link with Rommie to verify the team's story firsthand — it buys the bridge and ship's systems, but hands an unknown AI a look at everything Rommie has recorded.

options.label: Team — refuse the interface
options.summary: Keep Rommie's memory to themselves and decline the link — safer for Rommie, but Maia's suspicion stands and the bridge stays locked.

2106776610502238604.title: Maia's Bargain
2106776610502238604.question: Should the team agree to help Maia purge the ship's intruder in exchange for full system access?

options.label: Team — agree to Maia's deal
options.summary: Help Maia purge the intruder in exchange for the bridge and ship-wide access — restores the freighter, but commits the team to fighting an unknown threat.

options.label: Team — refuse the deal
options.summary: Turn down Maia's offer and look for another way in — avoids the fight she's picked, but leaves the ship locked down and the intruder unaddressed.

2107138998250492164.title: The Long Way Around
2107138998250492164.question: Does the team follow Maia's detour around the reactor leak, push straight through, or hold while Rommie confirms it?

options.label: Team — push straight through
options.summary: Ignore the warning and walk straight into the vented compartment — fastest route to the bridge, but lethal exposure if Maia's telling the truth about the leak.

options.label: Team — follow Maia's detour
options.summary: Trust Maia's read on the ship and take the long way around — safer if she's honest, but drifts the team further off course and deeper into her control.

options.label: Rommie — confirm the leak first
options.summary: Hold the team back and send shielded Rommie to verify the leak herself — costs time, but checks whether Maia is steering them true before committing.

2107501385637855667.title: Three Crises, One Hour
2107501385637855667.question: With a route-home clue, a fading life sign, and a reactor racing toward breach, does the team chase one lead or split up to catch them all?

options.label: Wait — let Rommie crack the data
options.summary: The team holds at the bridge while Rommie finishes decoding the derelict's database, gambling the way-home clue is worth leaving the life sign and reactor unattended.

options.label: Chase the fading life sign
options.summary: The team rushes to find the life sign before it fades, risking that it's the hostile entity Maia warned about and leaving the reactor countdown to run.

options.label: Race to engineering, vent the drive
options.summary: The team heads straight to engineering to vent the reactor by hand, saving the ship first but leaving the life sign and the data clue to wait.

options.label: Split up — O'Neill divides the team
options.summary: O'Neill splits the team three ways, for the life sign, engineering, and the bridge, so everything gets handled at once, but no group is at full strength.

options.label: McKay — draw and fire
options.summary: He opens fire to drive the machines off the core, risking a stray shot that ruptures the reactor itself.

options.label: McKay — run and warn the others
options.summary: He bolts from engineering to alert O'Neill and Daniel, saving himself but leaving Maia alone with the machines and the core unguarded.

options.label: McKay — trust Maia to handle it
options.summary: He holds back and lets Maia deal with the machines, betting her knowledge of the ship outweighs the risk that they're hostile.

options.label: McKay — head straight for the hangar
options.summary: He breaks for the hangar alone to regroup the team and start the evacuation without delay.

options.label: McKay — back up Maia at the bridge
options.summary: He sticks with Maia to the bridge, risking the extra minutes so they evacuate together once she's done.

2108588549012644146.title: First Mission: The Ghost Ship (Part 4) - "The Survivor"
2108588549012644146.question: What do you do?

options.label: Request transport
options.summary: Request transport.  Ask Scotty to lock onto Rhea and beam her straight to sick bay, if the pulses allows it.

options.label: Bring Rhea along and confront Maia
options.summary: Bring Rhea along and confront Maia.  Put them both in the same room and get the true story.

options.label: Keep Rhea hidden and regroup with the rest of the team fi…
options.summary: Keep Rhea hidden and regroup with the rest of the team first, then get to the bottom of it.
